panels.description: Alex, Ada and folded B11 crawl through the unwired service passage behind the apartment wall. Keep upper conduit clear.
B11 projects three mine markers while Alex studies a hand-drawn route scratched on the service wall. Keep upper projection clear.
The service passage emerges onto a lower maintenance lane leading toward Site 6; Alpha nodes remain dark along the old route. Keep upper lane clear.
Alex reaches the mine marker on B11's projection while Ada watches. Keep upper projection clear.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: We can reach it without the gate.
